sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Punisher - Part 5 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "The Masters — that's what my friends have started calling themselves — are moving on to the next stage. Now they need gear for this whole gladiator business. I'd help them myself, but I've got more important things to deal with. So you find what they need, and I'll make sure it gets to them in your name. Oh, one more thing: they wanted to see how good machine guns look in action... I'm sure you've already figured out what that means. Good luck out there, warrior!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find any Kalashnikov AK-74 assault rifle in raid
- Hand over the AK-74
- Find a Colt M4A1 assault rifle in raid
- Hand over the M4A1
- Find any 2 Makarov PM pistols in raid
- Hand over the pistols
- Eliminate 10 PMC operatives with Light machine guns
- Eliminate 20 Scavs with Light machine guns

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- 1× Kalashnikov AK-308 7.62x51 assault rifle
- 1× AK-308 7.62x51 QD sound suppressor
- 1x Documents case
- Unlocks purchase of Kalashnikov AK-308 7.62x51 assault rifle at Prapor LL4
- Unlocks purchase of AK-308 7.62x51 QD sound suppressor at Prapor LL4
"Got it all done? That's what I like to see! Here's your reward."
